Class MainMenuController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.ui.gui.MainMenuController
public class MainMenuController extends Object
Controller for the main menu scene in the GUI. Manages the sequential flow of pre-game screens: network configuration, login, lobby creation, and lobby selection. Each pane is shown or hidden depending on the current step, and the controller communicates with the Client to perform network operations on background threads.

This controller requires ViewGUI and SceneManager to be injected before the scene becomes active; failing to do so will cause a NullPointerException at runtime.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the controller after the FXML is loaded. Sets up the lobby table columns, the join button cell factory, and the initial visibility state of all panes.

    • onReconnectSuccess

      public void onReconnectSuccess()
      Called when a reconnection attempt succeeds. Stops the reconnection timer, hides all panes, and transitions directly to the game board scene.

    • updateLobbies

      public void updateLobbies(Map<Integer, List<LobbyDTO>> lobbies)
      Populates the lobby table with the available lobbies and switches to the lobby list pane. Must be called on the JavaFX application thread.
      Parameters:
      lobbies - a map from maximum player count to the list of lobbies with that capacity

    • onConnectClick

      public void onConnectClick()
      Handles the connection button click. Reads the IP address and selected network type, then attempts to create the client on a background thread to avoid blocking the UI. On success, transitions to the login pane; on failure, shows an error banner.

    • createClient

      private void createClient() throws NotBoundException, IOException
      Creates the appropriate Client implementation based on the selected network type, and wires it to the ViewGUI and VirtualModel. Called on a background thread by onConnectClick().
      Throws:
      NotBoundException - if the RMI registry cannot be reached
      IOException - if the socket connection cannot be established

    • onLoginClick

      public void onLoginClick()
      Handles the login button click. Reads the username from the text field and attempts to log in on a background thread. On failure, shows an appropriate error banner.

    • onLoginSuccess

      public void onLoginSuccess(String nickname)
      Called by ViewGUI when the server confirms a successful login. Transitions to the lobby choice pane, unless a reconnection flow is in progress, in which case it waits briefly for a reconnection confirmation before proceeding.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname that was accepted by the server

    • loadScene

      private void loadScene()
      Loads the game board FXML, wires a new GameController to it, registers the resulting root under the "game" name in the SceneManager, and switches the primary stage's existing Scene to that root.

      The root is (re-)registered on every call, since a new GameController is created each time a game starts. Swapping only the scene root via SceneManager.switchTo(String), instead of building a brand-new Scene and assigning it with stage.setScene(...), keeps the stage's existing fullscreen state intact and avoids the resize/fullscreen flicker that previously occurred on this transition.

    • returnToMenu

      public void returnToMenu(String reason)
      Sends the player back to the network configuration pane, typically after a disconnection from the server. Sets the reconnect flag so that the next successful login triggers a reconnection attempt rather than a fresh lobby flow. Shows the given reason in the error banner if non-empty.
      Parameters:
      reason - the reason for returning to the menu, displayed in the error banner; may be null or empty if no message should be shown

    • returnToLobby

      public void returnToLobby(String reason)
      Sends the player back to the lobby choice pane, typically after a match ends normally. Shows the given reason in the error banner if non-empty.
      Parameters:
      reason - the reason for returning to the lobby, displayed in the error banner; may be null or empty if no message should be shown

    • showError

      public void showError(String message)
      Displays an animated error banner with the given message. The banner slides in from the top and fades out automatically after 4 seconds.
      Parameters:
      message - the error message to display; should be non-null and non-empty

    • positionBackButton

      private void positionBackButton()
      Positions the back button proportionally to the size of its parent pane.

      Computed once when the scene becomes available: the stage is always fullscreen and its size never changes afterward, so a one-time calculation is enough. This compensates for the fixed pixel anchors defined in MainMenu.fxml (bottomAnchor="150.0", leftAnchor="150.0"), which were tuned for the design resolution (1280x720) and would otherwise be misplaced on different screen resolutions.

    • onExit

      public void onExit()
      Handles the quit button click. Terminates the JavaFX application.
